% Source: TeX Live 2025 tkz-euclide manual, TKZdoc-euclide-marking.tex
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.75]
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/O,5/0/A,3/4/B}
  \tkzMarkAngle[size=4,mark=x,arc=ll,mkcolor=red,mkpos=.33](A,O,B)
  \tkzMarkAngle[size=2,mark=||,arc=ll,mkcolor=blue,mkpos=.66](A,O,B)
  \tkzDrawLines(O,A O,B)
  \tkzDrawPoints(O,A,B)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
